about: Every point where the mod touches Fallout: New Vegas. One row = one hook. Scripts are plain text run by JIP LN NVSE's script runner (Data/NVSE/Plugins/scripts), so no .esp and no GECK are needed. provider: vanilla = base game script call, xnvse = xNVSE 6.4.9 (Melty installs it), jip = JIP LN NVSE (bundled, GPL-3.0). Every call name was checked in the xNVSE 6.4.9 / JIP LN source; verified=true only once it works in the running game.

columns.id: unique hook id, referenced by other sheets
columns.call: the script call that implements it
columns.runs: when it runs: once_per_session | each_load | per_tick | on_event
columns.verified: true once tested in the running game

rows.call: GetINIFloat "Section:Key" "csnv_cs2.ini" (reads Data/config/csnv_cs2.ini written by the launcher)
rows.notes: Pulls the CS2 values from cs2_settings into script variables; missing file or key falls back to cs2_settings.default
Looks up every weapons.base_form, weapons.ammo_form and the caps form; prints 'CSNV error: form <id> missing' to the console for any that fail

rows.call: CloneForm <base> then SetName, SetAttackDamage, SetWeaponClipRounds, SetWeaponFireRate, SetWeaponIsAutomatic; clone stored with AuxVarSetRef "CSNV_<weapons.id>" on the player
rows.notes: Creates each weapon once per save; later loads reuse the stored clone and re-apply the sheet stats
Opens the buy screen on the player's CS2 buy key; ignored while any menu is open (MenuMode)
The buy screen itself; the lambda gets the clicked button index (0-based) and runs pay/give for that buy_menu row

rows.call: SetOnMenuOpenEventHandler <lambda> 1 1001, then InjectUIXML "MessageMenu" "Data\menus\csnv\csnv_buy.xml" while the CSNV buy flag is set
rows.notes: Adds the CS2-style panel, header and price list (buy_screen sheet) on top of the game's message menu; MessageMenu is rebuilt each time, so it is injected on every open
HUD armor; New Vegas armor is DT, shown as the CS-style armor number
HUD ammo: rounds in clip / reserve; hidden when the equipped weapon uses no ammo
Money shown as caps on the HUD and buy screen
Silent remove after the caps check passes
Weapon and starter ammo land in inventory and the weapon goes to hand
HUDMainMenu stays loaded, so one injection per game session (guarded by a temporary '*' aux variable)

rows.call: CallWhilePerSeconds 0.1 <lambda> <condition lambda>, writing with SetUIStringEx / SetUIFloat
rows.notes: Pushes the per_tick reads into the hud rows and applies the crosshair values
Hides the vanilla readouts our HUD replaces; re-applied each tick because the game re-shows them
